title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: always-on diagnostics for macOS devices (roadmap phase 1)
summary: Hold: the alternative Activity explorer route omits Data Loss Prevention, where Microsoft says that navigation starts. The principal controls, licensing background and roadmap facts are supported, and the briefing correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting statements about macOS support.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 499432 is phase 1 of Always-on diagnostics for macOS Endpoint DLP endpoints.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention -- Always-on diagnostics for macOS endpoints (Phase 1)
